messages:
Asha - DevEx: quick FYI: hit a flaky repro where x-request-id disappears after an auth retry in our sampleapps. Happens on Node and Python. Otel enabled. Has anyone seen cross-lang propagation loss like this?

Ben - SDK: likely retry helpers rebuilding the request without copying headers. Can you paste minimal logs?

Asha - DevEx: logs: ```
INFO incoming headers={x-request-id: r-42, authorization: Bearer A}
WARN auth refresh triggered status=401
INFO retrying request headers={}
```

Cam - SampleApps: that pattern screams "new request without headers". Our Node example had `const opts = { method, body }` in retry wrapper (no headers). Python had `requests.Request(method, url, data=body)` without prepared.headers.

Daria - Infra: also double-check tenant redact rules. We saw one demo config with `.*id.*` which will strip x-request-id from logs even if present. Two separate failure modes.

Ben - SDK: short-term remedies: 1) change sampleapps to preserve headers (use clone/copy), 2) SDK instrumentation add a one-time WARN when context has an active span but outgoing request lacks traceparent/x-request-id. File an issue.

Cam - SampleApps: fixed Node & Python in PRs: copy headers into retry opts and reuse PreparedRequest. Added unit that simulates 401->refresh and asserts x-request-id on retry. PRs: https://rwd.in/pr/6201 & https://rwd.in/pr/6202

Asha - DevEx: added onboarding note: "Avoid greedy redact regexes like `.*id.*`; prefer explicit allowlist for headers." Also added a tiny troubleshooting section about AsyncLocalStorage/contextvars and retries.

Daria - Infra: infra action: create a staging integration test that triggers refresh and asserts trace continuity. Also updated redact example in console templates.

Ben - SDK: filed rwd.in/issue/1783 to add runtime warn+metric sdk.propagation.missing_on_retry (opt-out via env). Will also add an advisory lint to flag retry helpers that reconstruct requests without header copy.

BistroBot: CI: Node sampleapp staging check shows trace continuity restored after PR merge.

Asha - DevEx: verified staging, x-request-id survives retry now. Closing loop. Thanks all :thumbsup:
